# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first mobile browser rhythm game titled **Overworld Diva Harp**. Preserve the source mechanics: four perspective lanes, beat-scheduled notes traveling toward bottom hit pads, lane selection by horizontal tap position, perfect/great/miss timing windows, score/combo/energy HUD, energy-loss failure, and restart.

Theme it as a satirical Zelda-inspired music quest with pixel art, cottagecore and barbiecore cues, and meme-tone copy. The focal identity is a cute melody sprite and ceremonial harp-sigil in a pastel grove. HUD terms should include Rupee Remix, Vibe Hearts, and Its Giving Sync. Use browser-native CSS/Canvas/SVG-like primitives and safe user-gesture WebAudio tones; keep all controls readable and tappable in 4:7 to 9:16 portrait viewports.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The source is a browser-native four-lane rhythm tapping game. A canvas renders perspective lanes, notes spawn on beats, notes travel toward bottom hit pads, and pointer/touch input maps horizontal position to one of four lanes. Correct timing awards score and combo; missed notes or mistimed taps drain energy; energy at zero opens a game-over screen with final score and restart.

## Protected mechanics
- Four-lane x-position input model.
- Beat-based note spawn cadence and travel-time approach.
- Timing windows around the note hit time.
- Score, combo, energy, miss penalty, game-over, and restart semantics.
- Canvas main loop and mobile pointerdown actionability.

## Transformable presentation
Title, HUD wording, panel styling, background, protagonist/focal identity, note motifs, lane icons, particles, feedback text, audio tones, and onboarding copy are safe to transform because they do not alter the gameplay rules.

## Rebuilt target
Overworld Diva Harp keeps the protected rhythm loop but reframes it as a satirical Zelda-adjacent music quest in a pixel cottage/barbie grove. The public surface is a single rebuilt index.html with inline CSS/JS and procedural Canvas art.
